remarks: Fall in love with this spectacular open-concept ranch in the coveted Laurel Ledge Park Association. The kitchen is truly a showstopper, featuring a soaring ceiling with skylights & beams; abundant cabinetry; and a walk-in pantry. The centerpiece of the kitchen is a stunning quartz-topped island with a breakfast bar, perfect for entertaining. Equipped with two full-size sinks, a propane range, a wall oven, and, of course, a microwave and a dishwasher, this kitchen is a chef's dream. The kitchen seamlessly flows into the dining and living areas, creating an inviting space for gatherings. The foyer perfectly separates the main living areas from the four bedrooms. The primary suite features his and hers closets and an en suite bathroom, while the three additional bedrooms share a spacious hall bathroom. The multi-room walkout lower level, which opens to the bluestone patio, provides additional living space, ideal for any combination of playroom, gym, home office, and/or guest room - the choice is yours! Plus, the home is equipped with an automatic backup generator for peace of mind. Just down the street, the community pool offers the luxury of swimming without the hassle of maintenance.
